Description: Chakra theme extension is the primary way to customize the design system
Do: Define all colors fonts spacing in extendTheme()
Don't: Hardcode values in components or inline styles

Description: Use semantic names mapped to color scales in theme config
Do: Create named color scales (brand success warning) in theme
Don't: Use raw hex values throughout components

Description: Set heading and body font families via theme config
Don't: Import fonts only in CSS without theme config

Description: Use defaultProps in component theme to reduce repetition
Do: Define size variant colorScheme defaults in theme components
Don't: Pass same props to every component instance

Description: Use baseStyle variants sizes in component theme config
Do: Centralize component styles in extendTheme({ components: {} })
Don't: Scatter style overrides across many component files

Description: Apply spacing via theme token numbers (4 = 16px)
Do: Use numeric spacing props like p={4} m={6} gap={8}
Don't: Use arbitrary pixel values in style props

Description: Define responsive breakpoints in theme config
Do: Set breakpoints matching your design system
Don't: Use hardcoded media queries in components

Description: ChakraProvider must be at root with your theme
Do: Single ChakraProvider at app root with custom theme
Don't: Multiple ChakraProviders or missing provider

Description: colorScheme controls the color palette used by the component
Don't: Manually setting bg and color on each state

Guideline: Use size prop for consistent sizing
Description: Components accept size prop (xs sm md lg) for predefined dimensions
Don't: Set custom padding and fontSize on each instance

Guideline: Use variant prop for style variants
Description: Components support variant prop (solid outline ghost subtle)
Don't: Recreate variant styles with manual props

Description: Chakra provides boolean props for disabled and loading states
Don't: Manually managing disabled state and spinner display

Description: Button supports icon props for consistent icon placement
Don't: Wrapping icons and text in custom flex containers

Description: as prop changes the rendered HTML element
Don't: Creating wrapper components just to change element type

Guideline: Use sx prop for one-off styles
Description: sx prop accepts theme-aware style objects for edge cases
Do: sx for one-off styles that don't warrant theme extension
Don't: sx for styles that should be in the theme

Description: Direct style props (bg p m) are more readable than sx
Don't: Putting everything in sx when style props exist

Guideline: Use Box as base layout primitive
Description: Box renders a div with style props
Do: Use Box for containers wrappers and generic layout
Don't: Use raw div elements with className or inline styles

Description: Flex is Box with display flex
Don't: Manual display='flex' on Box when Flex exists

Description: Stack VStack HStack add consistent spacing between children
Don't: Manual margin on each child element

Description: SimpleGrid provides responsive column layouts
Don't: Complex CSS Grid when SimpleGrid suffices

Description: Container centers content with configurable maxW
Don't: Repeated maxWidth and mx='auto' on custom Box

Description: Chakra supports [mobile tablet desktop] shorthand for responsive props
Don't: Separate components for different breakpoints

Guideline: Use responsive object syntax for named breakpoints
Description: Object syntax { base md lg } is more readable for complex responsive
Do: <Box p={{ base: 4 md: 6 lg: 8 }}> for named breakpoints
Don't: Inconsistent mixing of array and object responsive syntax

Description: AspectRatio maintains consistent width-to-height ratios
Do: <AspectRatio ratio={16/9}> for video and image containers
Don't: Manual padding-bottom hack for aspect ratios

Description: Heading renders h2 by default with theme-aware sizing
Don't: Raw h1-h6 tags without Chakra styling

Guideline: Use Text component for body text
Description: Text renders p with theme-aware typography props
Don't: Raw p or span with inline styles

Description: Chakra maps named weights to numeric values
Don't: Raw numeric weights when named tokens exist

Description: Font size can accept responsive array or object
Don't: Single fixed font size across all screens

Guideline: Set line height with lineHeight prop
Description: Use named lineHeight tokens for consistency
Don't: Arbitrary line-height pixel values

Guideline: Use useColorMode for dark mode toggle
Description: useColorMode hook provides colorMode and toggleColorMode
Don't: Manual class toggling or separate theme objects

Description: Returns light or dark value based on current color mode
Don't: Ternary with colorMode === 'dark' for every prop

Description: Set initial color mode and system preference detection
Don't: Hardcoded light-only design without mode support
Code Bad: No color mode config in theme

Guideline: Use semantic color names from theme
Description: Reference colors by semantic name not raw hex
Don't: Hardcoded hex values that bypass theming

Description: WCAG AA requires minimum contrast for text
Do: Test theme color combinations for sufficient contrast
Don't: Muted colors for body text or low contrast pairs

Guideline: Use color alpha with _dark semantic tokens
Description: Chakra supports semantic tokens for automatic mode switching
Do: Define semanticTokens in theme for automatic switching
Don't: Separate component logic per color mode

Description: FormControl provides context for label error and helper text
Don't: Standalone Input without label or error context

Description: isInvalid on FormControl propagates error styling to children
Don't: Manual red border and error text styling

Description: InputGroup with InputLeftElement or InputRightElement for icons
Don't: Absolute positioning for input icons

Description: Chakra Select wraps native select with consistent styling
Don't: Raw HTML select without Chakra styling

Description: Configure Input focus styles in theme not per-component
Do: Define Input variant focus styles in extendTheme components
Don't: focusBorderColor on every Input instance

Description: Chakra provides CheckboxGroup and RadioGroup for grouped controls
Don't: Manual state management for radio/checkbox groups

Guideline: Use transition prop for smooth state changes
Description: Chakra components accept transition prop for CSS transitions
Don't: No transitions on hover/focus state changes

Description: Chakra provides underscore-prefixed pseudo prop shorthands
Don't: onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave state management for hover

Description: Chakra exports motion components compatible with framer-motion
Do: Use chakra factory with motion for animated Chakra components
Don't: Heavy custom animation logic without framer-motion integration
Code Good: import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}>
Code Bad: Custom CSS keyframe animations for enter/exit

Description: Honor user motion preferences in animations
Do: Check prefers-reduced-motion and disable complex animations
Don't: Ignoring motion preference settings
Code Bad: Forced animations regardless of user preference

Description: Chakra components render semantic HTML with proper ARIA
Do: Button renders <button> Link renders <a> with correct roles
Don't: Using Box with onClick instead of Button

Description: Icon buttons need accessible labels for screen readers
Don't: Icon button without aria-label

Guideline: Use VisuallyHidden for screen reader text
Description: VisuallyHidden renders content only for screen readers
Don't: No screen reader context for visual-only indicators
Code Bad: Badge with count but no sr-only text

Guideline: Manage focus in modals and drawers
Description: Chakra Modal traps focus and returns it on close
Do: Use Chakra Modal with built-in focus management
Don't: Custom modal without focus trap or return

Description: Ensure all interactive elements are reachable via Tab key
Do: Logical tab order matching visual layout
Don't: tabIndex manipulation that breaks natural order
Code Good: Natural DOM order with Chakra interactive components
Code Bad: tabIndex={-1} on interactive elements removing keyboard access
